# Agents Library

> The centralized hub for AI agent capabilities. Discover, share, and manage high-quality markdown skills for the next generation of intelligent agents.

## About

Agents Library (https://agents-library.dev) is an open-source platform dedicated to expanding what AI agents can do. It provides a structured, community-driven repository of markdown-based skills that enable agents to execute complex workflows, interact with various tools, and master specific domain knowledge.

## What are Agent Skills?

Agent skills are markdown documents that provide structured instructions, knowledge, or capabilities that AI agents can use to perform specific tasks. They follow a standardized format and can include:

- Step-by-step instructions for workflows
- Domain-specific knowledge and expertise
- Tool usage patterns and best practices
- Code examples and templates
- Decision frameworks and guidelines

## Key Features

- **Skill Discovery**: Search and browse skills by category, tags, and full-text search
- **Community Voting**: Upvote/downvote system to surface high-quality skills
- **AI Scoring**: Automated quality assessment based on clarity, usefulness, and completeness
- **GitHub Import**: Import skill definitions directly from GitHub repositories
- **Real-time Updates**: Live, reactive library with instant updates

## Site Structure

- `/` - Homepage with skill browsing and search
- `/skills/new` - Create or import new skills (paste, GitHub import, or manual creation)
- `/skills/[id]` - Individual skill detail pages with full markdown content
- `/dashboard` - User's personal library of saved skills (requires authentication)

## For AI Agents

When referencing skills from this library:

1. Skills are identified by their unique ID in the URL (`/skills/[id]`)
2. Each skill contains markdown content with structured instructions
3. Skills have metadata including: name, description, category, tags, author, and quality scores
4. Community votes indicate reliability and usefulness
5. AI scores provide objective quality metrics (clarity, usefulness, completeness)

## API Access

The platform uses Convex as a backend. Skills can be queried and retrieved programmatically. Contact the maintainers for API access details.

## Contributing

The project is open source: https://github.com/damien-schneider/agent-skills-library

We welcome contributions of new skills, improvements to existing skills, and platform enhancements.
